scope: Discovery layer only: email metadata -> classifier -> email body -> 0..N JobCandidates
dataset_type: sanitized real-world Gmail-derived cases plus one synthetic regression fixture derived from a real production failure
notes: This is a small expanded baseline, not a production-scale benchmark.
Positive cases preserve real job-alert structure but redact personal data and ephemeral tracking tokens.
Negative cases are job-adjacent emails that contain career/employer language but no concrete job opening.
Location is reviewed manually for semantic groundedness and is not exact-string scored.
Case REG-01 is a synthetic regression fixture abstracted from a real production failure where the extractor emitted a JobCandidate with an empty company and stopped the Agent Run.
